shadows.name: command-palette
shadows.purpose: Floats the command palette above the page.

motion.name: portfolio-ease
motion.purpose: Used for select control and drawer transitions.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Suppresses transitions and smooth scrolling for users who request reduced motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact blue action used for the main portfolio pathway.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: #1567d8; color: #fffaf1; font: 700 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1), background .25s ease, outline-color .2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0c4f9f; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1567d8; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined contact action beside the primary link.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 19px; border: 1px solid #101f33; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: #101f33; font: 700 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.25,1), background .25s ease, color .25s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #101f33; color: #eef4fa; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1567d8; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Pale, lightly bordered contact form field.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 7px; color: #334761; font: 700 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 46px; padding: 10px 12px; border: 1px solid #bcbfb5; border-radius: 3px; background: #f8faff; color: #101f33; font: 400 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; transition: border-color .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: #1567d8; outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(39,110,176,.18); }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Sticky paper navigation with a fine lower rule.
components.html: Sufyan Mohammed FarooqWorkAboutContact
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; min-height: 70px; padding: 0 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid #bdc9da; background: rgba(238,244,250,.97); color: #334761; font: 600 .72rem Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-nav strong { margin-right: auto; color: #101f33; font: 700 1.25rem/1.1 Pliant, 'Bricolage Grotesque', Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #0c4f9f; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #1567d8; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Project Media
components.description: A rectangular media window where the project interface leads.
components.css: .ds-project-media { display: flex; aspect-ratio: 1.65; align-items: center; justify-content: center; overflow: hidden; background: #e2eaf5; color: #101f33; }

components.name: Metadata Tag
components.description: Small outlined mono label used for categories and project metadata.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; padding: 3px 7px; border: 1px solid #bdc9da; border-radius: 2px; color: #53647b; font: 500 .72rem DM Mono, monospace; letter-spacing: .025em; text-transform: uppercase; }

narrative.overview:
The portfolio reads like a considered field journal about useful technology: clear section numbering, monospaced annotations, fine rules, and confident typography organize the story. Cool paper surfaces and deep navy ink keep the page calm and legible, while blue marks the key actions, links, and ideas that deserve emphasis. The portrait and project interfaces remain the authentic evidence at the center of the experience.

The visual system pairs editorial structure with practical clarity. Its spacing gives each project and career detail room to be read, while repeated labels and hairlines make a long single-page portfolio easy to scan. Blue and navy carry the chosen identity; the slate-blue secondary tone softens supporting details.
keyCharacteristics: Cool blue paper, deep navy ink, and a decisive blue accent.
Numbered field-note labels set in DM Mono.
Large, compact display headlines paired with readable Manrope body copy.
Fine rules and restrained corner rounding keep the work in focus.

rules.name: The Blue Signal Rule
rules.body: Reserve the strongest blue for actions, focus, active emphasis, and small editorial signals; let the pale paper and navy ink do most of the work.

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the display face for hierarchy, Manrope for reading and interaction, and DM Mono for annotation; do not use the mono face for paragraph copy.

dos: Do use the paper, ink, and accent tokens for page surfaces, text, and actions.
Do use fine rules and mono annotations to support scanning across the long portfolio.
Do keep the supplied portrait and project interfaces photographic and recognizable.
Do preserve visible keyboard focus and the reduced-motion accommodation.
donts: Don't introduce unrelated accent colors into the portfolio chrome.
Don't place project screenshots inside generic elevated cards; let the artifact lead.
Don't use rounded pill shapes as the default form for controls or metadata.
